feedback_signal: UI changes repeatedly needed a correction from a superseded review-popover contract or inactive DashboardView component toward the approved pipeline-posture contract and active ReleaseEvidenceView surface.
root_operational_failure: Repository guidance still names a superseded specification and mockup as the default UI entrypoint while the active app renders a newer release-evidence surface, leaving agents without a deterministic route from current intent to current implementation.

durable_improvement.action: Add a repository-contract test that requires the approved pipeline-posture specification to be the default UI route and preserves the older review-popover specification as explicitly historical.
durable_improvement.prevents: Future UI work from treating a superseded specification or inactive private component graph as the current implementation authority.

commands.evidence: The focused regression test passed after AGENTS.md and README.md were routed to the approved 2026-07-10 pipeline-posture contract and after the inactive private legacy DashboardView graph was removed. The same command first failed in the red phase because those current-route references were absent. A fresh QA disproof then found the guard incomplete; the test now also asserts, in both maintained documents, that the 2026-07-09 materials are historical/reference-only and non-default. The exact focused command passed again after that test-only recovery.

proof.future_behavior: Current UI guidance and the focused contract test must agree that the pipeline-posture specification and ReleaseEvidenceView are the default route, while the review-popover materials remain historical reference only.

implementation_note: The approved correction is deliberately narrow: update routing documentation, add a contract-level regression test, and remove only source roots independently verified as private and unreferenced. No runtime or Tessl claim changes are authorized.
